claims.statement: DeepSeek’s documented /models example names the current API id deepseek-flash as DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash, with a 1,048,576-token context window, 393,216 maximum output tokens, text and image input, text output, and low/high/max effort with high default. The example shows no other V4.1 member; it is a documentation example, not an authenticated account query.
The same documented /models example lists deepseek-v4-pro as DeepSeek-V4-Pro with 1,048,576 context and 393,216 maximum output tokens. This V4 Pro entry is not a V4.1-Pro member.
